fields.statement: QA cycle 1 with the binary built at HEAD c345f85e6. Live: this QA check session's own `rhiza session done --dry-run --json` (check qa, cycle 1, no round yet) exits 3, code conflict, message names `rhiza run findings --check qa -`, next `rhiza run findings --check qa`. Scratch repo with a hand-written review run journal (step checks, check bugs, cycle 1): check session refused (exit 3) naming rhiza run findings and written no done mark; after a findings round (blocker f1, major f2, nit f3) it says done. Critic with f1,f2 unjudged refused naming `rhiza run verdict --check bugs -` and listing (f1, f2); after f1 confirmed still refused listing (f2); after f2 dropped it says done with nit f3 unjudged. Fixer session says done with no round. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run SessionDone passes.

QA cycle 1 with the binary built at HEAD c345f85e6, in a scratch repo (rhiza init, change set with capability leaf-a, actors ada and bob) with a hand-written build run journal (leaf-session builder and verifier on leaf-a attempt 1). Builder session done succeeds. Verifier with nothing recorded: exit 3 conflict naming `rhiza run findings --leaf leaf-a -`, session status stays unset (no done mark). After bob writes Evidence verifying leaf-a via rhiza apply: still refused, message says leaf-a-bob was written by another actor. After a findings entry on attempt 1: a verifier of attempt 1 says done. A verifier of attempt 2 is refused until ada writes her own Evidence, then says done. Human text form prints 'Session ... is done.'. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run SessionDone passes.

QA cycle 1 with the binary built at HEAD c345f85e6: `rhiza guide build` and `rhiza guide review` both say each role ends with `rhiza session done` as its own command after its recording command succeeded. `rhiza workflow describe <w> --json` for build, review, plan, plan-milestone and ship-change: no prompt contains '; rhiza session done' or '&& rhiza session done', and every mention of rhiza session done is matched by 'very last action' (2/2, 8/8, 5/5, 5/5, 16/16). grep over .rhiza/workflows and internal/ finds no chained done. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run 'Build|Review' and ./internal/workflow pass.
